scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
